summary: GlobalFoundries filed a Form 6-K reporting its July 28, 2026 Annual General Meeting results and the resignation of director Elissa Murphy, effective immediately. Murphy resigned for reasons unrelated to any disagreement with the company; Martin L. Edelman also did not stand for re-election, reducing the board from thirteen to eleven directors. The AGM approved the election of three Class II directors (Kerko, Lazar, Obeid) with strong shareholder support and ratified the appointment of PwC as auditor. These are ordinary governance events, not a forced departure or activist-driven change. No special-situation catalyst is present.
